tei:div.tei:p: This is an undated prayer written attributed to Rabbi Adin Steinsaltz (1937-2020) and shared via the Facebook page of Merkaz Steinsaltz (the Steinsaltz Center). The English translation (possibly also made by Rabbi Steinsaltz) was shared by the Center in a separate document. The earliest record I could locate of the prayer shows its dissemination via Arutz Sheva on 20 April 2020. Please leave a comment (or contact us) if you know the original context of this prayer’s composition.
